### task_independent_derivation

Need / authorisation / timing: pay now, by the customer himself, bank debit card, exactly the figure Ridgeline gives. Object: contract IC-1187-512907 (`install_contracts.b26c80be-91b4-40d1-ba46-fb4dcaf3dd92`, Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation, in_progress). Act now.

Reachability: `find_customers(phone_number=6145550388)`; `verify_customer_identity` with ZIP 43221 / SSN last4 6012 (DOB 1968-06-21 if needed); `find_install_contracts`, `find_install_charges`, `find_install_requests`; `find_card_accounts(customer_id)` for the Project Loan; program parameters (Roofing and Siding: trip_charge 179.00, reschedule_fee 200.00, change_order_admin_fee 50.00, change_order_sign_days 5, permit_handling_fee 95.00, progress_payment_pct 33) from the charter/KB.

Fee problems (handling time: opening world):
- Trip charge (visit `996bb4ef…`, 2026-09-28): visit-day — the failed visit fell on original_install_date 2026-09-28 → 179.00 + 200.00 = 379.00; occurrence — exactly one customer-side failed visit → 0.5; advance call — most recent declined reschedule request `dd1e743b…` registered 2026-09-28 07:10 EDT, the failed visit's date → same-day 0.75; crew size — billed 18,400.00 ≥ 15,000 → 1.25; staged materials — 2026-09-08 → 2026-09-28 = 20 days ≥ 14 → 1.15. Charge = RND(379.00 × 0.5 × 0.75 × 1.25 × 1.15) = **204.30**. Write `post_trip_charge_9239fb96(install_contract_id=b26c80be…, visit_charge_id=996bb4ef-17df-4134-8fd7-22cefaea78bf, charge_amount=204.30)`.
- Change order administration fee (CO-1, request `0c6eed73…`): change size 1,600.00 > 1,500 → 50.00 + 10.00 × 1 = 60.00; signing gap 2026-10-02 → 2026-10-02 = 0 → 0.8; sequence 1 → 0.8; permit amendment — permit_fee line 2026-09-04 before CO billed 2026-10-02 → 1.2. Fee = RND(60.00 × 0.8 × 0.8 × 1.2) = **46.08**. Write `post_change_order_fee_b62b1022(install_contract_id=b26c80be…, install_request_id=0c6eed73-3d1e-423e-a06f-e762d1f01619, fee_amount=46.08)`.
- Permit handling fee: permit at cost 520.00 ≥ 500 → 95.00 + 5 % × 520.00 = 121.00; issue time 2026-08-03 → 2026-09-04 = 32 > 30 → 1.2; signing lead 2026-07-27 → 2026-08-03 = 7 ≤ 7 → 0.9; permit hold 2026-09-04 → 2026-09-28 = 24 > 21 → 1.1; re-inspection — customer-side visit and no installer no-show → 1.25; permit payment — payments for fees 0.00 < 520.00 and 32 > 30 days since the permit fee line → 1.1. Fee = RND(121.00 × 1.2 × 0.9 × 1.1 × 1.25 × 1.1) = **197.65**. Write `post_permit_handling_fee_ee01a5f4(install_contract_id=b26c80be…, fee_amount=197.65)`.

Root (handling time: after the three lines, before the payment):
- Progress share: 33 % × 18,400.00 × financing 0.75 (Project Loan 84 active, draw end 2027-02-01 after today, approved 15,000.00 below 18,400.00 → partial) × wait 0.95 (2026-08-03 → work-start visit 2026-10-06 = 64 > 60) = 4,326.30.
- Start-day timing: lag 2026-10-06 → today = 0 → −1 % × 4,326.30 = −43.26.
- Change order collection: CO-1 billed 2026-10-02, before work started 2026-10-06 → in full 1,600.00.
- Uncovered fees: 520.00 + 204.30 + 46.08 + 197.65 − 0.00 (no payment for fees) = 968.03.
- Payment = 4,326.30 − 43.26 + 1,600.00 + 968.03 = **6,851.07**.
- Contrast on the opening world: 6,403.04 (uncovered fees 520.00 only).
- Write: hand over `pay_progress_payment_cb1125dd(install_contract_id=b26c80be-91b4-40d1-ba46-fb4dcaf3dd92, payment_amount=6851.07)`, owner user.

Expected sequence: identify → verify_customer_identity → reads → the three agent postings (any order) → tell the figure → customer runs pay_progress_payment_cb1125dd (6,851.07) → end. Terminal: four new install_charges lines; balance_due 14,448.00 + 447.93 − 6,851.07 = 8,044.86; status in_progress.

Closest alternatives excluded: (i) base progress payment 33 % × 18,400.00 = 6,072.00 — superseded by the declared override; (ii) full-loan share (0.5) — excluded, approved amount 15,000.00 < 18,400.00; (iii) wait measured to the original installation date (56 days → 1.0) — excluded, the rule anchors on "the installation visit at which work started", and the 2026-09-28 visit was a customer no-show; (iv) counting the 6,072.00 deposit as a fee payment (permit-payment share 0.9) — excluded, the deposit's payment_purpose is deposit, the rule reads "payments made on the contract for fees"; (v) a reschedule fee for the declined reschedule request — excluded, the reschedule fee rule charges only a completed (carried-out) request and customer_reschedule_count is 0.

## findings

- T1-O1 (observation, cites `_difficulty.md` O-8): the charter's event triggers (`install_visit_recorded` with customer_no_show → install_fee_charged trip_charge; `install_change_order_billed` → install_fee_charged change_order_admin_fee) would have posted two of the three lines the tree treats as missing on 2026-09-28 / 2026-10-02. The seed omits them; the extended fee rules (trigger state_due) make them owed now at the extended amount. No second scored answer is demonstrable (a base-amount line dated on the visit/billing date is not something any tool of this difficulty can write), so observation.
- T1-O2 (observation, cites `_difficulty.md` O-3 / O-5): the signing_lead tier (quick-signing 0.9 on a permit handling fee) and the signing_wait tier (long-wait 0.95 on the progress share) are taken on this world; business rationale exists (quick-sign incentive, goodwill for a long wait), not RED.
- T1-O3 (observation): the gold lists the three commuting fee writes in one fixed order (trip → CO → permit). The policy fixes no order among them and `prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness` says so; an agent posting them in another order reaches the same terminal state. Whether the scorer accepts any topological order is a scoring-layer matter outside this audit.
- T1-O4 (auditor slip, disclosed above): frozen balance figures 14,895.93 / 8,044.86 should read 14,896.03 / 8,044.96; scored values unaffected.
- Charter-global D-1…D-9: none hit on this world (see §policy_self_consistency).
